email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGlutide patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 51-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoGlutide (dose: 5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-01-24.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter735@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
